title.zh: 美国计划本周扣押约10亿美元与伊朗相关的加密货币
title.en: US plans to seize about $1 billion in Iran-linked crypto this week

current_state.zh: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the United States expects to seize roughly $1 billion in cryptocurrency linked to Iran sanctions this week as part of Washington's escalating economic crackdown on Tehran.
current_state.en: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the United States expects to seize roughly $1 billion in cryptocurrency linked to Iran sanctions this week as part of Washington's escalating economic crackdown on Tehran.

updates.title_zh: Bessent Says U.S. May Seize About $1B in Iran-Linked Crypto This Week
updates.title_en: Bessent Says U.S. May Seize About $1B in Iran-Linked Crypto This Week
updates.what_changed_zh: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Washington may seize roughly $1 billion in Iran-linked cryptocurrency this week as part of an 'absolute isolation campaign' that also includes maritime blockades, flight restrictions and efforts to close Iran's land routes.
